summary.text: Kenan Judge is a Democratic member of the Iowa House of Representatives, District 27, where Ballotpedia lists his tenure as beginning in 2019, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. He previously worked as a vice president at HyVee.

paragraphs.text: Kenan Judge was born in Georgetown, Iowa, and graduated from Albia High School.
His career experience includes working as vice president of meat, seafood and deli with HyVee.
He has served as chair of the Waukee Area Christian Services Annual Gala Committee and has been affiliated with the Iowa Homeless Youth Center.
For 2025-2026 Judge serves on the Agriculture, Commerce, Natural Resources, and Ways and Means committees, and he was ranking member of the Commerce Committee in 2023-2024.
